description: MCP server: 5,000 years of military strategy and philosophy — Napoleon, Sun Tzu, Clausewitz, Alexander, Hannibal, Genghis Khan, Shaka Zulu, Caesar. All public domain.

tools.name: napoleon_maxims
tools.description: Get Napoleon Bonaparte's Military Maxims — 115 principles distilled from 20+ years of campaign experience. The most concentrated body of military wisdom from any commander in the modern era. Use for strategic planning, logistics, speed of decision, and concentration of force.

tools.name: sun_tzu
tools.description: Get Sun Tzu's Art of War — 13 chapters on strategy, intelligence, deception, and the nature of conflict. The oldest continuously studied strategic text. Applies to competitive analysis, negotiation, organizational strategy, and any domain of structured competition.

tools.name: commander_doctrine
tools.description: Analyze a commander's signature tactical innovation — the battle doctrine that made them historically decisive. Covers: Napoleon (corps system, central position), Alexander (hammer and anvil), Hannibal (Cannae encirclement), Genghis Khan (feigned retreat + Mongol doctrine), Shaka Zulu (bull-horn formation), Caesar (fortification + speed), Frederick the Great (oblique order).

tools.name: apply_strategy
tools.description: Apply classical military principles to a modern strategic problem. Translates ancient military wisdom into business, technology, organizational, or geopolitical analysis. Specify the problem domain and the analytical lens.

tools.name: public_domain_library
tools.description: Get major works of military and strategic philosophy available in the public domain. Returns title, author, date, themes, and key insights for each work.
